Technology rises from 42.5% to 46.9%; Consumer cyclical falls from 19.7% to 17.3%, and Financial services from 8.1% to 6.1%.","The replayed maximum percentage drops change from 56.4% to 55.4% for the 2008 crisis, 30.7% to 30.0% for Covid, and 32.8% to 33.3% for 2022. The corresponding dollar drops rise from $8,460 to $11,087, from $4,604 to $5,998, and from $4,927 to $6,663.","Past SPY history shows that after the 2009 bottom, the market gained 71.9% over 1 year and 114.3% over 3 years; recovery to its prior level took 41.3 months. After the 2020 bottom, it gained 77.5% over 1 year and 84.6% over 3 years; recovery took 4.6 months. These are past results, not forecasts.","For context, the investor is saving with 39 years to retirement and a Moderate risk profile.
